dashboard.title: Your room for growth
dashboard.subtitle: Clear your mind — keep tasks, goals, and thoughts in one place
descriptionSentences: MindHaven is a space to move everything that's usually spinning in your head.
You no longer need to keep tasks, goals, and worries in memory — they're always at hand.
Here it's easier to see the big picture and understand where you're heading.
As you build goals, you gradually uncover new details that help you move forward.
The journal helps you reflect, capture thoughts, and observe yourself from the outside.
The AI assistant offers guidance, helps refine your plan, and reveals possible sources of anxiety.
At every step — in goals, tasks, or entries — you get support and clarity.
Free your mind from the noise and focus on what truly matters.
